name: AIS
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.96). Replaced keyword guess "input-validation".
rootCause: There is no access control in AIS::setSwapPairs, allowing the attacker to set pairs to arbitrary addresses. The attacker sets Pancakeswap as a valid pair and transfers tokens to the pair through AIS::transfer, subsequently executing the Pancakeswap::skim operation to profit.
